_about: Input for scripts/platform-status.sh. Each card names its Jira keys; the chip is derived from their live Jira status (all Done -> Working in DEV; all To Do -> Planned; otherwise In build). 'override' replaces the chip text where TJD-640 requires it.

cards.title: Merge gate
cards.body: Merges exactly the commit an independent QA run approved, with the gate script pinned by hash.

cards.title: Budgets and policy
cards.body: Hierarchical budgets and evidence-based policy refinement for agent work.

cards.title: Customer plane baseline
cards.body: Exact IAM per principal, KMS keyring and signed build provenance for the customer's app repo.

cards.title: Grounded read-only chat
cards.body: Read-only chat over project data through a client-funded embeddings credential.

cards.title: Builder PRs on your repo
cards.body: The builder opens its pull request on the project's own bound repository.

cards.title: Signed policy snapshots
cards.body: Policy snapshots signed by a DEV signing key and accepted live.

cards.title: Freeze and stop
cards.body: A hot brake that freezes or stops agent runs. Not claimed as tested.
